yt.title: The Philippines had 63% of Japan's population in 2000. Now? #Shorts
yt.description:
Total population, the Philippines as a share of Japan, 2000 vs 2025. Source: World Bank (SP.POP.TOTL).
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Japan has long been one of the most populous countries in Asia. Here is how the Philippines compares, and how that changed.
In 2000, the Philippines had sixty-three percent as many people as Japan. By 2025, it had ninety-five percent.
The Philippines keeps growing, while Japan's population is not. Population shapes labor, demand, and growth. What would you compare next?
